verdict.rationale: Probes confirm that OpenAI's developer docs hub serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of pages, including the Agents guide. An agent can therefore be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, this is a vendor-wide hub at developers.openai.com, not the SDK's own documentation site at openai.github.io, so how much SDK-specific coverage it gives an agent is unproven. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or markdown export on the SDK's own docs site (openai.github.io/openai-agents-*), confirmation that the hub's index covers SDK API/reference pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
